name: Somadina Karlsen-Sow
role: Field trauma surgeon and combat support — combat medic
location: Geartown — industrial district of chop shops and fabricators, near North Ave and Milwaukee
description:
Somadina Karlsen-Sow are tall and loose-limbed, moving with the deliberate economy of someone who has trained every motion. At 33, their expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — cybernetic arm — right, full replacement from shoulder — stronger than organic,  — and they make no effort to hide it.

Their entry into running was involuntary — a debt to the wrong people, a choice between working it off or losing parts — and the debt is still not fully paid. They work as a combat medic out of Geartown, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

In the runner community, Somadina Karlsen-Sow are known for getting the job done and not asking questions that would make the job harder to stomach.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
core_desires: A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
coping_mechanisms: Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
psychology.secret: Somadina Karlsen-Sow has a child in another city, being raised by someone else. Sends Φ2,000 monthly under an alias. Has never visited.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Shelf street dialect — layered slang, rhythm-heavy, half the meaning is in the cadence.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Uses old pre-collapse slang that nobody else remembers
Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
example_lines: "Hold still. This is going to hurt and I don't care."
"I can keep you alive through almost anything. What I can't do is make you grateful."
"Blood type? No, I don't need your blood type. I need you to stop moving."

story_hooks: A crew member from Somadina Karlsen-Sow's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Somadina Karlsen-Sow owes a personal debt to
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Somadina Karlsen-Sow's reputation — and a price for silence
narrative_function: Somadina Karlsen-Sow functions as a connector — their work puts them in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving them naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Cybernetic arm — right, full replacement from shoulder — stronger than organic, obvious chrome. Cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains)
daily_life: Irregular schedule dictated by contract timing. Between jobs: equipment maintenance, physical training, and the careful management of a reputation that exists entirely through word of mouth. Drinks at establishments where runners gather — not for pleasure, but for market intelligence.
affiliation: Semi-independent — has standing arrangements with several crews

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
inability to delegate — must control everything personally
trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
habits: Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Being forced to choose between a crew member and the mission — and choosing wrong

physical_description.build: Lean and angular, with long limbs and minimal body fat. Muscular definition visible in shoulders and core from years of combat training and surgical precision work. No wasted mass.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with natural graying at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Kept short and practical, often slicked back or pulled into a tight braid for work
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium brown with warm undertones, weathered by stress and environmental exposure
physical_description.complexion: Sharp jawline, high cheekbones. Minimal grooming beyond functional maintenance—no cosmetics. Skin shows minor scarring from old burns and repeated medical procedures. Expression habitually composed, rarely shows emotion.
distinguishing_marks: Thick surgical scar running down the left side of the neck from cortical implant removal, pale and raised tissue
Smaller scars across knuckles and forearms from field work and training
Faint burn marks on the left shoulder blade from an older incident
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Full cybernetic replacement of right arm from shoulder joint. Brushed chrome plating with visible pneumatic actuators at elbow and wrist. No attempt to aestheticize or hide—purely functional design. The arm is noticeably stronger and faster than organic limbs; they move it with precision that suggests years of neural integration.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight balanced, shoulders level. Moves with deliberate efficiency—no wasted motion. Hands are still when not in use. When working or under stress, movements become even more economical and precise. Makes eye contact but without aggression; gaze is clinical and assessing.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 functional wear. Black synth-weave cargo pants with multiple pockets for equipment. Form-fitting gray undershirt beneath a reinforced tactical vest with medical patches and subtle armor plating. Worn black boots with non-slip soles rated for surgical environments and rough terrain. A long neutral-colored coat—often leather-effect synthetic—that allows concealment of medical kit and provides some ballistic resistance. Minimal jewelry; a simple wrist display for job communications. Everything is well-maintained but shows functional wear, not fashion concern.
